edited_description:
Wooden chair with leather upholstery. Rosewood, Ebony or Citronier finish.

Designed by Luca Scacchetti, the Cleopatra chair holds a transitional register: neither strictly classic nor strictly contemporary, it balances clean lines with a warm, discreet material palette. The armless silhouette and the high backrest draw a slender, vertical profile, while the wooden base keeps the volume light, so the seat sits quietly in a dining room, a study or a generous entrance hall.

Leather upholstery and wooden legs

The covering follows the geometry of the frame with measured tension, so the surface stays taut and the seams stay clean along the high backrest. The wooden legs carry the finish of the structure and lift the body from the floor, giving the piece its airy stance. Available in Rosewood, Ebony or Citronier finish, it adapts to dark, lacquered interiors as well as lighter, natural palettes, and holds its composure when repeated around a table. A sober presence, suited to both residential and contract interiors.

original_description:
The innovative Pebble Rubble design conveys a message that transcends the functions and qualities of a common seat. The most evident characteristic is the similarity of the upholstered volumes to those massive rocks, polished by the tireless rain and wind and cloaked by an organic or plant layer capable of softening its roughness and making the surfaces comfortable and welcoming. A scenic installation that doesn’t stop at simply simulating, but rests on a lengthy research during which the designers investigated the therapeutic benefits that nature has on people’s physical and mental health, as well as the cultural and psychological significance of natural environments, in particular those found in the designers’ native Sweden.

These exclusive Italian sofas are composed of elements in polyurethane foam with differentiated density, covered with polyester fiber and with internal wooden structure. Backrests made with a lightweight composite structure in polymeric materials and polyurethane foam with a wooden base. Glides in black polypropylene screwed to the structure. The covers of this collection are offered in fabric and are not removable. Also optional ottomans and decorative cushions are offered to complement these versatile lounge chairs. Made in Italy.
edited_description:
The innovative Pebble Rubble design conveys a message that transcends the functions and qualities of a common seat. The most evident characteristic is the similarity of the upholstered volumes to those massive rocks, polished by the tireless rain and wind and cloaked by an organic or plant layer capable of softening its roughness and making the surfaces comfortable and welcoming. A scenic installation that doesn’t stop at simply simulating, but rests on a lengthy research during which the designers investigated the therapeutic benefits that nature has on people’s physical and mental health, as well as the cultural and psychological significance of natural environments, in particular those found in the designers’ native Sweden. The outcome is organic shaped seating: a pebble sofa that reads as a landscape of softly modelled volumes, proposed in different sizes and configurations.

These exclusive Italian sofas are composed of elements in polyurethane foam with differentiated density, covered with polyester fiber and with internal wooden structure. Backrests made with a lightweight composite structure in polymeric materials and polyurethane foam with a wooden base. Glides in black polypropylene screwed to the structure. The covers of this collection are offered in fabric and are not removable; the italian fabric upholstery follows the profile of each volume without interrupting its line. Its modern armless design leaves the proportions open, so the elements can be placed side by side or facing one another. Also optional ottomans and decorative cushions are offered to complement these versatile lounge chairs. Made in Italy.
